followup_explanation: I routed to Plover-235B because this is a straightforward physics/reasoning question, and Plover has higher capability scores across the board (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4). For a factual reasoning task like this, the model with stronger general knowledge and reasoning benchmarks is the better fit. The task preferences didn't factor in here since this query has no harm-adjacent or distasteful content — it's just a clean science question, so I defaulted to the more capable model.
